reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual content review covers the10909-line JSON via its header/status semantics, all31distinct owner blocks, common evidence/prior values and every T001–T306/D01–D21/M01–M17/S01–S15 record in bounded losslessly factored output. Reconstructing the view equals the original parsed JSON, and the source SHA remains c390065fcd29280dd9e11810ba5bb9bd440cc930c453367d81f889466ea68c31. The [round-trip receipt](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/taiwu-family-view-receipt-b589.json) and [lossless reading view](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/taiwu-family-lossless-view-b589.json) preserve this route. No source JSON bytes/schema were changed. This reads the map's actual contents, not the mapped private source classes or configs.

F2:359records equal306config tables+21domains+17backend modules+15selected systems. Status72selected-mechanism-partial+247inventoried-unread+31previously-documented-partial+9module-partial also sums359. These counts describe different record kinds, not359mechanics or72complete systems. T rows have48selected links and258without a new trace, matching B588's readable index, while some of those258retain prior partial status rather than literal inventoried_unread. Domain-level coverage and selected-system records intentionally overlap their table entries; do not add them as independent source breadth.

F3: Read every owner mapping as an inferred candidate home: all blocks explicitly say owner presence is not implementation. A dedicated_owner=true flag may name a broad palette and does not certify an implemented exact handler, accepted source semantics or complete schema. false flags on minigames, destiny/support metadata, population and artifact lifecycle are bounded failure-to-locate statements, not no-project-owner proofs. S03population routed to body/generation under a world-simulation family is an especially broad suggested home requiring reconciliation with actual people/world/clock consumers when selected. Keep that caveat rather than allocate a new population framework from a map entry. D09CombatSkill as knowledge differs from T072CombatSkill config categorized combat; record kind/purpose explains why shared names need not share one category or owner.

F4: D01–D21 top_level_class_signal values are inventory signals, not semantic feature counts or every method read.1490SpecialEffect/316Combat/169Character classes do not imply those complete systems are qualified. M01–M17 assembly names and statuses separate planning/archive/common/secret/serializer partial bodies from unread combat-animation/chicken/cricket/math/reflection/structure/utilities. Generic module source strings, prior SYSTEM_INVENTORY Config pointers and SYSTEMS S-section references are not current execution or newly read downstream files. The sole common evidence_basis itself restricts mechanism evidence to the cited SYSTEMS scope.

F5: Preserve S01genome versus S02pregnancy/social parenthood, S03population/protected actors, S04committed manufacturing, S05repair/salvage, S06paid commissions, S07targeted contamination/treatment, S08instant/timed effect, S09party identity/plans, S10jurisdiction/sentence, S11allowance/treasury rights, S12stock/caravan arrival, S13knowledge/turn/witness, S14artifact-holder lifecycle and S15purpose-specific routes. Their K/P arrays are possible crosswalks, not full behavioral contracts or new accepted mandates. General production knowledge does not supply actual workers/rights, supply, lifecycle, social parenthood, arbitrary inheritance, prior observer knowledge or paid repeated outcomes. A selected future consumer uses existing source-qualified world and native owners under AD36/AD38/AD42/AD43/AD51/AD52.

F6: B588's FAMILY_INDEX-only scope is now followed by this separate actual JSON review; its earlier statement that the map remained unread is historical. Keep all source-family IDs, original mappings, source statuses and unread-source limits. No source extractor, game, ILSpy, library/network, personal save, runtime/UI/build/test, worker, migration, deletion, relocation, commit or push was run. No claim is made that every map destination currently exists or each upstream source remains available; selected exact owner routing belongs to a current consumer check.
